messages:
Maya: Heads up — during onboarding runs the sample app flooded our staging API with 429s. Seems client-side prefetch + retries.
Ravi: which SDK and settings?
Maya: go-sdk v0.10.1, sampleapp default. Found prefetch_pages=3 and retry.backoff_ms=10.
Sam: ah that short backoff + prefetch will create tight retry storms. Are retries hedged or sequential?
Priya: retries spawn immediately and are independent of paginator prefetch. So 3 prefetch * up to 2 retries = bursts.
Maya: minimal repro config I used: client.retries.max=2, client.retries.backoff_ms=10, paginator.prefetch_pages=3, paginator.concurrency=6.
Ravi: short-term: change sampleapp defaults to backoff_ms=100 and prefetch_pages=1.
Priya: long-term: SDK should count hedged/retry attempts against the same concurrency quota and add jitter to backoffs. Also expose a global in-flight cap.
Infra-bot: incident logged INC-2026-client-prefetch-retry-burst assigned to eng-devex.
Sam: add an e2e that injects 429s and asserts in-flight <= configured concurrency. Block if it regresses.
Maya: I'll open a small PR to adjust sampleapp defaults and add a troubleshooting note in the quickstart about combining prefetch with aggressive retries.
Ravi: please also add a telemetry counter for "retry_attempts" so Console shows the multiplier.
Priya: agreed. We should also add an automatic client mode that throttles prefetch when 429 rate exceeds a threshold.
Maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/520 toggles safer defaults and docs.
Sam: great work, thanks. :thumbsup:
